scope: Dedicated Mechanical Engineering asset and audit only. Master and shared indexes were not edited.

geometry_changes.operation: Applied existing estimated 0.28 m wall thickness and boolean-cut 208 window openings plus one arched entrance opening through the main GIS shell.
geometry_changes.placement_method: Window modules repeated on long boundary edges of Purdue GIS FID 857; entrance face selected from the long edge whose outward normal points toward the Engineering Fountain, then centered on that edge.
geometry_changes.dimensions_status: Photo-derived qualitative proportions only. Exact opening schedule, window spacing, doorway size, facade-to-wing mapping, and door position are not measured.

geometry_changes.operation: Added dark window glazing and mullions, stone window sills/headers and approximate floor bands, an arched limestone entrance surround, dark double-door glazing, generic plaque silhouette, and building-name lettering.
geometry_changes.source_support: Qualitative facade categories visible in Purdue's 2025 official exterior photographs and a 2024 dated Wikimedia Commons photo. No facade dimensions were inferred from the images.

geometry_changes.operation: Replaced shell shading with a meter-scaled procedural running-bond brick, variable brick colors, mortar, and subtle bump response.
geometry_changes.color_status: Qualitative visual match, not measured or color-calibrated. No external texture dependency.

unchanged: Purdue GIS FID 857 horizontal envelope, asset root, and placement origin [66.30000114440918, 86.5]
Modeled shell top at 18.5 m; no height or floor elevations were changed
Estimated existing floor plates and plan-traced partitions
Separate FID 108 shell and all master placement markers

fountain_coordinate_reference.uncertainty: Used only to select a candidate fountain-facing GIS edge; not survey control. Purdue's renovation page independently states the new main entrance faces the Engineering Fountain.

candidate_fountain_facing_edge.door_position_status: Estimated at edge midpoint; exact along-wall position is not established by the direction statement or unregistered photos.

remaining_uncertainty: The shell remains a single 18.5 m high extrusion even though Purdue sources identify five wings from different periods; calibrated heights and wing-by-wing roof levels are unavailable in the evidence set.
The long-face window pattern is an evidence-informed visualization, not an independently verified elevation schedule; exact orientation and counts on all other faces remain uncertain.
The doorway is on the GIS edge oriented toward the fountain but placed at its midpoint by estimate; no georeferenced facade image pins its along-wall position.
GIS FID 108 remains unchanged and its relationship to FID 857 needs a separate source/geometry review.
Existing floor plates and partition geometry remain approximate. Plans are historical and do not cover Gatewood; current interior routing and room finishes are not verified.
The 2015 planning study and 2026 OEP description differ on east-wing construction dates. Purdue's recent history page gives only the five-phase range from 1929 to 2012.
